title: Whereabouts Of Mrs. Dorothy Lee K.A. Forester

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3575
Date 28. 4. 32

April 28 32

Dear Sir,

With reference to your letter of March 19,
1932, I have to state that Mrs. Dorothy Lee left
Shanghai for England on board the s.s. "Gange" on
April 11, 1932.

Yours faithfully,

Assistant Commissioner (Special Branch)
for Commissioner of Police.

K. A. Forster, Esq.,
11 Kelvin Avenue,
Bedford,
England.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Special Branch & S.B. REGISTRY
No. 3575
Date April 28 1932.
Dte 28/4/32）

Subject (in full) Attached letter ref Mrs. Dorothy Lee.

Made by D.S. Moore. Forwarded by DSD. [签名]

Regarding attached letter from Mr. K.A. Forster
seeking information concerning the whereabouts of his daughter,
Mrs. Dorothy Lee of 25 Elgin Road. Inquiries reveal that the
lady in question left Shanghai for England aboard the Lloyd
Triestino S.S. "Gange" on April 11, 1932.

DSB Moore
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

事由（全称） 附函，关于多萝西·李（Dorothy Lee）夫人。

由 警佐 穆尔（Moore）拟写。经 副警司 转发。[签名]

关于 K.A. Forster 先生的附函，其询问居住在埃尔金路25号的女儿多萝西·李（Dorothy Lee）夫人的下落。经查，该女士已于1932年4月11日乘坐意大利劳埃德三隅公司（Lloyd Triestino）的“恒河”号（S.S. "Gange"）轮船离开上海前往英国。

警佐 穆尔
警佐

特别股主管警官。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3573.
11 Kelvin Avenue, 27/4/32
BEDFORD.
19th March 1932.

The Shanghai Municipal Council,
Bureau of Public Safety,
SHANGHAI.

Dear Sirs,

I am anxious to trace the whereabouts of my
daughter, Mrs Dorothy Lee of 25 Elgin Road, Shanghai,
from whom I have not heard for many months, and you
will realise how keen I am to have news of her.

This morning I telephoned the Chinese Legation
in London and they said that if I wrote to you they were
sure you would be able to help me.

I should therefore esteem it a great favour
if you could give me as much information as you possibly
can.

Thanking you in anticipation,

I am,

Yours faithfully,

K. a. Forster

S2. For attention. I think she has just
left or is about to leave for home
D.S. Moore 27/4/32.
J.H.G.
27:4:32.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 3573。
贝德福德，开尔文大道11号，1932年4月27日
1932年3月19日。

上海公共租界工部局，
警务处，
上海。

尊敬的先生们：

我急切希望查明我女儿、居住在上海埃尔金路25号的多萝西·李（Dorothy Lee）夫人的下落，我已数月未收到她的音讯，你们可以想见我是多么渴望得到她的消息。

今天上午我致电中国驻伦敦公使馆，他们表示如果我致信给你们，相信你们能够给予帮助。

因此，如蒙尽可能向我提供相关信息，我将不胜感激。

先此致谢，

此致

敬礼

K. a. Forster

S2. 请阅。我认为她刚刚离开或即将启程回国
警佐 穆尔 1932年4月27日。
J.H.G.
1932年4月27日。
